name: The Trial of Victor Maxstein
source:
You have died and are set to be judged in the afterlife

Answer 5 questions to determine wherever you deserve heaven or hell.  

[From [url=https://drnoir.itch.io/the-trial-of-victor-maxstein] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经死去，即将在来世接受审判。回答五个问题，决定自己是否应当进入天堂或地狱。

[来源：[url=https://drnoir.itch.io/the-trial-of-victor-maxstein]itch.io[/url]]
